test_unscoped_enum: test pybind11 unscoped enum string representation, name property, members, and int comparison behavior
test_scoped_enum: test pybind11 scoped enum string representation and verify it rejects int comparisons with TypeError
test_implicit_conversion: test implicit conversion of class-scoped unscoped enums and verify hashing works as dictionary keys
test_binary_operators: test pybind11 enum flags binary operators including bitwise OR, AND, NOT, and XOR operations
test_enum_to_int: test converting pybind11 enums to int, uint, and long long integer types
